rejected_commits.reason: Linked, but it is the 5.1 commit that introduced FullLoader (the vulnerable feature), not the fix. It is in tag 5.3 (the last vulnerable release), so the release check rejects it.

truth_evidence: Fix commit 5080ba5 (PR #386, 'Prevents arbitrary code execution during python/object/new constructor'), in tag 5.3.1 and not in 5.3. https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/commit/5080ba513377b6355a0502104846ee804656f1e0

FullConstructor.set_python_instance_state (lib3/yaml/constructor.py, line 577 before the fix) gains an 'unsafe' parameter and calls check_state_key on every state key unless unsafe is true. The same change is mirrored in the Python 2 copy lib/yaml/constructor.py.

Entry points: everything that loads with FullLoader. construct_python_object_new -> construct_python_object_apply -> set_python_instance_state; both constructors were still registered on FullConstructor in 5.3.
